proposals.title: Exposure concentration: by_regime + by_signal_type×regime×sector = Choppy (100%) + UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank (21.05%) (100.0%)

claim.what: Concentration risk: by_regime + by_signal_type×regime×sector = Choppy (100%) + UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank (21.05%); recommended action: Pause new entries in Bank sector until UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell share drops below 0.15 via natural exit; block additional UP_TRI or BULL_PROXY adds until regime-diversification (non-Choppy exposure) is introduced or Choppy×UP_TRI cohort promotes above Candidate tier.
claim.expected_effect: Trader awareness of tail risk: If regime flips from Choppy to Bear or a sharp mean-reversion hits, 100% directional-long exposure with 21% concentrated in Bank on an unvalidated Choppy×UP_TRI cohort takes a correlated drawdown with no offsetting positions — the monoculture amplifies loss with zero cohort-validated edge to justify the posture.

evidence: UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell share=0.2105 (4/19), breaches 0.20 cell threshold
Five concentrated cells (Bank, Infra, Pharma, Metal, Other) all map only to Candidate-tier cohorts
risks: Recommendation may be over-cautious; concentration may be edge-validated
Trader may already be aware; informational only

proposals.reversibility: Informational warning; no system mutation. Suppresses on next run if concentration drops below threshold.

decision_metadata.recommended_action: Pause new entries in Bank sector until UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell share drops below 0.15 via natural exit; block additional UP_TRI or BULL_PROXY adds until regime-diversification (non-Choppy exposure) is introduced or Choppy×UP_TRI cohort promotes above Candidate tier.
decision_metadata.tail_risk_scenario: If regime flips from Choppy to Bear or a sharp mean-reversion hits, 100% directional-long exposure with 21% concentrated in Bank on an unvalidated Choppy×UP_TRI cohort takes a correlated drawdown with no offsetting positions — the monoculture amplifies loss with zero cohort-validated edge to justify the posture.
decision_metadata.llm_rationale: Regime concentration is triggered at 100% Choppy (19/19, well above the 0.80 threshold) AND the UP_TRI×Choppy×Bank cell breaches the 0.20 cell threshold at 21.05% (4/19). UP_TRI is 15/19 = 78.9% and combined with BULL_PROXY the book is 19/19 = 100% directional-long — a full monoculture. All concentrated cells match only Candidate-tier cohorts (Choppy×UP_TRI n=278, Choppy×BULL_PROXY n=33) — unvalidated edge across all concentration axes, extending a multi-week warn streak.
